lane: datum-offset: Lake Lahontan shorelines as a strain gauge. The lane's standalone emission is measured below chance (0.61x isolated-random control) so this session carries the lane forward as (a) three datum features in the detector - isobase residual, datum band, |residual| - and (b) the calibrated instrument. Deviation logged for the selector; the drift tripwires below are evaluated mechanically.
hypothesis: The organiser's own 19-band numerical stack contains enough signal to predict where experts map faults that are ABSENT from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue. The 79 public submissions with owner-reported scores are 79 measurements of that hidden set, and the measurable profile of the 0.26-0.2778 family (mass 37-44k, hard-core isolation, off-catalogue, near-uniform 10 km coverage, LiDAR-scarp affinity ~83) is a necessary condition for that band.
mechanism: 34 features (19 organiser bands + 9 derivative/texture/coherence layers + 2 catalogue-geometry layers + 3 Lahontan-datum layers) -> HistGradientBoosting trained on a consensus surrogate under 6 spatial blocks -> one out-of-fold surface (mean blocked AUC 0.9585) -> priority = OOF * (LiDAR ex_max/255 + 0.05)^2 with a 300 m catalogue standoff -> hard-core emission of the 40,000 highest 7x7 local maxima (every pair >= 400 m apart).
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: (a) the training target is the CONSENSUS OF PRIOR PUBLIC SUBMISSIONS, not the organiser's truth: a detector that predicts it reproduces the group's shared bias - range-front scarps, alluvial-fan toes, magnetic lineaments that are dykes or lithologic contacts; (b) magnetic-gradient and tilt highs mark igneous contacts and dyke swarms; (c) isostatic-gravity gradients mark basin edges and sediment-thickness changes with no Quaternary slip; (d) the LiDAR ex_max composite also fires on terrace risers, dune crests, beach ridges and channel banks - and inside this lane's own window, wave-planed Lahontan benches and deltaic terraces produce 2-3 m steps with no fault; (e) geodetic strain-rate layers are smooth and highlight inter-seismic loading, not discrete traces.

instruments.label: MEASURED-INSTRUMENT (a projection is never written as a score)

vote_inversion.construction: nested quantiles of the score-weighted vote V(g)=sum_i s_i max_x k(d(x,g)); q chosen by minimum sum of squared ABSOLUTE residuals of the exact published index, no free scale; feasibility T_i <= |S| enforced
vote_inversion.VERDICT: REFUTED as an instrument for a NEW field. It reproduces owner-reported scores at held-out rho 0.913 across registry artifacts, but the surrogate is by construction the kernel footprint of the winning fields, so the champion's own credit on it (0.324 per dot at K=13,294) is unattainable by any field that is not a re-emission of the winners. This field scores 0.32-0.35x the champion on it, which is a statement about novelty, not about quality.

reward_model.construction: 11 locally measurable field properties -> implied per-dot credit and score, gradient boosting, 5-fold leave-artifact-out CV on 47 distinct fields
reward_model.LIMIT: h34-scatter-q50-arr-matched has the same mass and the same credit_sgmc as the champion and scored 0.0778 against 0.2778, so no set of aggregate properties certifies placement quality. The model ranks families, not fields.

sgmc_compilation.REFUTED: the registry field with credit_sgmc = 0.9312 (99.9 % of its dots within 300 m of SGMC-1:750k faults absent from the catalogue) scored 0.0360, so the state compilation's gaps are NOT the hidden truth; placing dots on it is refuted. credit_sgmc is retained only as a weak family descriptor (Spearman +0.195 over 47 distinct fields).

detector.leakage_reading: no single feature exceeds 0.90 AUC on the blocked holdout (max 0.757, detelev_gradmag_max5), so the canary is not tripped. The pooled 0.9585 is above 0.90 and is disclosed: the target is a consensus of fields built from these same public layers, so a high blocked AUC means the consensus is reproducible from primary data - it is not evidence about the organiser's hidden labels.

submission_note: 62e: 40k isolated dots, blocked OOF detector on the 19-band stack x LiDAR scarp. Uniqueness gate: DUPLICATE-STOP. Not for submission.
submission_decision: DO NOT SUBMIT. The parallel-run uniqueness gate tripped: 87.84 % of this field's dots lie within 3 px of the dots of one non-vacuous registry raster (limit 0.70), and 12,979 of the 40,000 dots (32.45 %) are EXACTLY that raster's pixels (chance expectation 0.78 %). The protocol says log and stop. The file is published for inspection and for learning only - it must not be uploaded to the competition.

duplicate_trip.gate: gems62.uniqueness (rank correlation <= 0.90; <= 70 % of dots within 3 px of one non-vacuous registry raster)
duplicate_trip.reading: The comparator GEMSDOE22 'h23-b-dti-optimal-emission-10pct' is a 516,738-cell DTI-optimal emission field that itself scored 0.0748. Two independent hard-core top-40k selections from priority surfaces built on the same public layers land on the same sharpest peaks, so the shared pixels are a consequence of the shared input, not of copying. That does not make it submittable: the gate is mechanical and it tripped, and 32 % of the field inherits the pixels of a low-scoring artifact.

verdict_reason: FORMAT LEGAL (14/14 receipt checks, values in [0,1], no nodata tag, EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, 100 m, transform asserted against the official sample) and perfectly isolated (minimum dot-to-dot separation 400.0 m, zero dots inside one 300 m kernel). It matches or beats the 0.2778 champion on every aggregate property this sandbox can measure - mass 40,000 vs 37,654; self-kernel 0.0000 vs 0.0173; evenness 569 vs 547 cells; credit_cat 0.0000 vs 0.0074; credit_sgmc 0.0697 vs 0.0655; LiDAR-scarp mean 112.6 vs 82.9 - but it fails the uniqueness gate, and it deviates on arrangement (dens21 4.56 vs 8.75-9.62, coh21 0.1595 vs 0.307-0.336) in the direction that h34-scatter shows is worth 0.0778 instead of 0.2778. No instrument available here can show this field beating the incumbent, and the protocol forbids spending a slot on an idea that has not beaten the best local evidence.
irregularities_flagged: the mandated segmented holdout is structurally incapable of scoring this design: with a 300 m catalogue standoff every dot is outside the withheld catalogue positives, so pooled HOLDOUT-DTI = 0.0000 while its own random-dot control scores 0.0575 and its random-line control 0.0170. A holdout whose positives are mapped catalogue segments measures catalogue hugging, which the leaderboard punishes (IR-62-HOLDOUT-01). It is reported here for the record only and gates nothing
